title: `repeater` is wide in the form but narrow in the form designer — the two read the same set with different spellings
body:
Found by the spelling sweep for #4250 (the `richtext` / `rich-text` gap across four layout sets); filed unassigned per Prime Directive #10. Not fixed there: it is a different type family, and the sweep's own criterion says it is not the same defect — see "Why this is not #4250" below.

## The asymmetry

`WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` (both `packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts` and `packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`) is matched RAW and carries two spellings per type: the bare `@objectstack/spec` `FieldType` name, and the `field:` widget id that `mapFieldTypeToFormType` produces. For the embedded-array-of-rows type those two are spelled differently:

```
packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts
  repeater: 'field:grid', // embedded array of rows
```

The sets carry `grid` and `field:grid`. They do not carry `repeater`. So:

| caller | what it passes | result |
|---|---|---|
| the real form (`resolveColSpan`, `FormField.type`) | `field:grid` — already mapped | wide, spans the row |
| `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx:158` | `String(entry.def.type ?? 'text')` — the RAW object field type | `repeater` misses the set, renders narrow |

`ObjectFormDesigner` says in its own comment that it is mirroring the real form ("Mirror the real form: wide widgets (textarea/markdown/...) take the whole row"), which is exactly the property that does not hold for a `repeater` field.

## Why this is not #4250

#4250's defect is a member the spec REJECTS: `FieldSchema.safeParse({type: 'rich-text'})` fails, so that member could never match anything. `grid` is different — it is a sanctioned objectui-local key (`GridFieldMetadata` in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`), and `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/inlineEditTypeCoverage.test.tsx` names it explicitly as one of "the form-only keys (`owner`, `object`, `grid`, `geolocation`, the widget-hint pickers)". So `grid` is not a misspelling to drop; `repeater` is simply a second, spec-spelled way into the same widget that the bare half of the set never learned.

The mechanical sweep run for #4250 confirms the split: of 21 field-type-keyed Sets across `plugin-detail` / `plugin-form` / `app-shell`, the only members that are declared spec typo-aliases with the canonical spelling MISSING were the four `rich_text` / `rich-text` ones #4250 fixes. `repeater` is not in that class, which is why it was left out rather than ridden along.

## Impact

Cosmetic and confined to the Studio form designer's preview: a sub-table field is laid out narrow there and full-width in the form it is previewing. No data is lost, no runtime form is wrong. Filed as an observation rather than a defect for that reason — grade it in triage.

## Suggested shape

Add `repeater` beside `grid` in both `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`. #4250 lands a derived pin in each package (`autoLayout.wideSpelling.test.ts`) asserting that the set's spec-facing surface is EXACTLY `textarea` / `markdown` / `html` / `richtext`, and its comment already names this issue as the reason `repeater` is excluded — so that pin is where the decision gets recorded, and it will go red (by name) when this one is taken, which is the intended behaviour.
